appln_title: HIGH CONNECTIVITY PARAMETRIC GATE
appln_abstract: One or more systems, devices, and/or methods of manufacture and/or use provided herein relate to a quantum computing process to achieve higher connectivity of qubits to more than nearest neighbors and/or to a plurality of nearest neighbors. A system can comprise a tunable first coupler coupled to a first qubit, a tunable second coupler coupled to a second qubit, and a junction coupling the first coupler and the second coupler being both parametrically drivable. The first coupler and the second coupler can comprise superconducting quantum interference devices or Josephson junctions. The junction can comprise a central hub or central node separately coupled to the first coupler and the second coupler. The first coupler and the second coupler can be configured to capacitively or inductively couple the first qubit and the second qubit to one another to perform a control-Z (CZ) gate or an iSWAP gate.

appln_title: Simulation method and device, equipment and storage medium
appln_abstract: The invention provides a simulation method, device and equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of computers, in particular to the technical field of quantum computers, quantum chips and quantum simulation. According to the specific implementation scheme, the method comprises the following steps: determining a target association relationship corresponding to a first cavity in a packaging box for packaging the quantum chip; the target association relationship is used for representing a mapping relationship between a first candidate cavity feature parameter of the first cavity and a first simulation frequency corresponding to the first cavity; the first candidate cavity feature parameter can influence the frequency corresponding to the first cavity; obtaining a target simulation frequency corresponding to the first cavity based on the target association relationship; when it is determined that the target simulation frequency meets a first frequency requirement, obtaining a first target cavity feature parameter of the first cavity based on the target association relationship; the first frequency requirement is obtained based on the frequency of quantum bits in the quantum chip.

appln_title: Method and device for constructing quantum circuit corresponding to Bayesian network
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a method and device for constructing a quantum circuit corresponding to a Bayesian network, and the method comprises the steps: obtaining each node contained in a target network and a causal relationship between the nodes, constructing a first sub-quantum circuit in a superposition state for preparing quantum bits for a root node in each node, and constructing a second sub-quantum circuit in a superposition state for preparing a quantum bit; and for every two nodes with a causal relationship in each node, respectively constructing a second sub-quantum circuit corresponding to the causal relationship and used for coding conditional probability, and obtaining a quantum circuit corresponding to the target network according to the first sub-quantum circuit and the second sub-quantum circuit, thereby realizing a quantum implementation mode of the Bayesian network. According to the method, the calculation complexity of the Bayesian network is reduced, efficient calculation is realized, and the superposition characteristic of the quantum state is utilized, so that processing supporting a large-scale multi-node network model is realized with fewer storage and calculation resources.

appln_title: SUPERCONDUCTING QUANTUM COMPUTING SYSTEM AND QUANTUM BIT MANIPULATION METHOD
appln_abstract: Disclosed are a superconducting quantum computing system (600) and a quantum bit manipulation method. The system (600) includes a control system (610) and a superconducting quantum chip (620). The superconducting quantum chip (620) includes at least two connection regions (621) and a first central exchange region (622). Each connection region (621) includes a first suspended superconducting bit and at least one first superconducting bit. The first central exchange region (622) includes the first suspended superconducting bit, and is used to transfer a quantum operation between superconducting bits in different connection regions (621). A control circuit is configured to control a coupling strength between the first suspended superconducting bit and the first superconducting bit. Therefore, a single connection region (621) or a central exchange region can be isolated by controlling the coupling strength between the first suspended superconducting bit and the first superconducting bit, thereby effectively obtaining a divided subspace. A two-bit gate manipulation between different connection regions (621) may be transited by using the central exchange region. Therefore, various quantum manipulations required for general quantum computing can be implemented on a large-scale superconducting quantum chip (620).

appln_title: SEMICONDUCTOR-SUPERCONDUCTOR HYBRID DEVICE, ITS MANUFACTURE AND USES
appln_abstract: A semiconductor-superconductor hybrid device (200) comprises a semiconductor (10), a superconductor (18), and a barrier (14) between the superconductor and the semiconductor. The device is configured to enable energy level hybridisation between the semiconductor and the superconductor. The barrier is configured to increase a topological gap of the device. The barrier allows for control over the degree of hybridisation between the semiconductor and the superconductor. Further aspects provide a quantum computer comprising the device, a method of manufacturing the device, and a method of inducing topological behaviour in the device..

appln_title: Built-in air pump
appln_abstract: The utility model belongs to the technical field of air pumps, and particularly relates to a built-in air pump which comprises a shell and a machine core arranged in the shell, the machine core comprises a containing cavity, an air inflation motor, an air exhaust motor and an electromagnetic valve, the air inflation motor, the air exhaust motor and the electromagnetic valve are arranged in the containing cavity, the machine core is provided with an air inlet and an air outlet, and the air inflation motor and the air exhaust motor are both provided with internal gaps. A sealing one-way valve extending into the air outlet is arranged on the shell, and the electromagnetic valve can control the movement of the sealing one-way valve so as to control the opening and closing of the air outlet; the inflation motor, the air exhaust motor and the electromagnetic valve are all connected with the main board, and a sound control structure is further arranged on the main board. The air exhaust motor, the air inflation motor and the electromagnetic valve are assembled into a whole to form the machine core, the whole machine core is contained in the shell, when air inflation is needed, air inflation is carried out through the air inflation motor, and when air exhaust is needed, air exhaust is carried out through the air exhaust motor. And the starting of the inflation or exhaust action of the built-in air pump can be controlled through voice control, which is very convenient.

appln_title: Method and device for realizing network node sorting
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a method and a device for realizing network node sorting. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining to-be-sorted network nodes of which the number is not greater thanN, wherein N = 2<n>, and n is a positive integer; generating an N * N-dimensional adjacency matrix A according to the interaction relationship among the to-be-sorted network nodes; determining an out-degree Dout and an in-degree Din of the adjacent matrix according to the adjacent matrix A; according to the adjacent matrix A, the out-degree D<out> and the in-degree D, calculating an Hermitian matrix E and b<arrow>, wherein the Hermitian matrix E = [D<out> + D - (A + A<T>)], and b<arrow> = [D<out> - D]1<arrow>; and according to the value of the Hermitian matrix E and the value of the b<arrow>,outputting a quantum state S<*> containing a sorting result of the to-be-sorted network nodes by utilizing a quantum circuit corresponding to an HHL algorithm, wherein E, S<*> and b<arrow> meet a relationship that ES<*> = b<arrow>. The large-scale network node sorting efficiency can be improved, quick sorting of large-scale network nodes is achieved, the calculation amount of quantum circuits corresponding to the HHL algorithm is reduced, and the calculation efficiency of the quantum circuit is improved.

appln_title: Anti-quantum certificate issuing method and system based on public key pool and signature offset
appln_abstract: The invention relates to an anti-quantum certificate issuing method and system based on a public key pool and signature offset. Each participant comprises a certificate authorization center and a userand participant is configured with a secret key card. A public key pool, a private key and a public key pointer random number of the certificate authorization center are stored in each secret key card, a user public key pointer random number is further stored in the secret key card of a user, and when the certificate authorization center signs the adversarial quantum certificate, a holder publickey is obtained in the public key pool according to the holder public key pointer random number; a signature offset is calculated according to the holder public key and the holder public key pointer random number; an original text abstract is calculated according to the anti-quantum certificate original text. The original text abstract is signed by using a private key of a certificate authorization center and the signature offset to obtain an issuer signature. The anti-quantum certificate cannot be cracked by a quantum computer.

appln_title: Mentha haplocalyx cake pastry food flavoring process
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a mentha haplocalyx cake pastry food flavoring process comprising glutinous rice, polished round-grained rice, Shatian pomelo peel strips, mung bean, a peppermint essence, rose oil and other raw materials. The finished product is beautiful in color and luster, quietly elegant in cake color, cool, delicious, soft in texture, soft, moist, sweet, fragrant, rich in nutrients, and suitable for both old and young. Especially, the rose oil is added, lotus leaves wraps cake flour, and a bamboo tube is used for together steaming, so the product eats lubricant and smooth, is fragrant and also has unique faint scent flavor of bamboo and rose, and has the efficacies of cooling, dispelling wind and heat, and clearing heat from throat for benefitting throat.

appln_title: FLUX BIAS LINE LOCAL HEATING DEVICE
appln_abstract: Devices, systems, and/or methods that can facilitate local heating of a superconducting flux biasing loop are provided. According to an embodiment, a device (100) can comprise a substrate (102) having a superconducting flux bias circuit comprising a biasing loop (104) coupled to a flux controlled qubit device. The device can further comprise a heating device (106, 108) coupled to the biasing loop.

appln_title: METHOD FOR SURGICAL TREATMENT OF OPEN-ANGLE GLAUCOMA
appln_abstract: FIELD: medicine.SUBSTANCE: invention relates to medicine, namely to ophthalmology. Conjunctival incision 6 mm long 3 mm from the limbus is performed parallel to the latter. A superficial scleral flap of a square shape is cut out with a base at the limbus with a side of 5 mm by 1/3 of the scleral thickness, entering the surface layers of the cornea. A deep rectangular scleral flap is excised with a base of 3 mm and a height of 5 mm by 1/3 of the scleral thickness, 1 mm apart from the lateral walls of the superficial flap. This flap is excised together with the peripheral layers of the cornea and the outer wall of the Schlemm's canal, exposing the trabecular zone and Descemet's membrane until the intraocular fluid seeps out. In the part of the scleral bed facing the equator, a portion of the sclera is excised until the ciliary body is exposed. At the border of the formed scleral bed facing the equator, a rectangular sclera section with a base of 3 mm and a height of 1 mm is excised by 2/3 of the sclera thickness. The superficial scleral flap is placed in place and fixed with two single sutures in the corners of its free edge. The conjunctiva is sutured with a mattress suture.EFFECT: method provides a prolonged hypotensive effect in the postoperative period due to the formation of a direct flow of fluid from the intrascleral bed into the subconjunctival space without the formation of scleroscleral and scleroconjunctival adhesions.1 cl, 1 dwg, 1 ex

appln_title: Semiconductor quantum device ESD protection
appln_abstract: An electrostatic discharge (ESD) protection circuit is configured to protect a target circuit that operates in a cryogenic temperature is provided. The ESD protection circuit connects a terminal of the target circuit and a ground potential with no connection to a bias potential. When the ESD protection circuit receives a voltage potential at the terminal of the target circuit, the ESD protection circuit (i) disallows electrical current to flow through from the received voltage potential when the device is at a cryogenic temperature and (ii) allows electrical current to flow through from the received voltage potential when the device is at a room temperature.

appln_title: Superconducting quantum chip and flip bonding chip spacing control method
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a superconducting quantum chip and flip bonding chip spacing control method. The method comprises the following step that: according to design requirements, the number, positions and area of crimping bodies are determined, and the number, positions and area of supporting bodies are determined, the supporting area of the supporting bodies is larger than the crimping area of the crimping bodies, the supporting bodies and the crimping bodies are made of the same material, and the height of the supporting bodies along a first direction is related to an inter-chip target distance, and the first direction is the direction in which chips are crimped. The supporting bodies and the crimping bodies are made of the same material, so that the supporting bodies and the crimping bodies can be prepared in the same process step, and the process flow is simplified; and the supporting area of the supporting bodies is larger than the crimping area of the crimping bodies, so that when crimping is carried out under certain pressure and temperature and the distance between the chips is reduced to be the same as the height of the supporting body with a larger area, the distance between the chips is not changed any more or only slightly changed due to larger resistance in the crimping process, and therefore, accurate control and uniformity of the distance between the chips are realized.

appln_title: Quantum communication system without polarization feedback and quantum secure direct communication method
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a quantum communication system without polarization feedback and a quantum secure direct communication method. The quantum communication system comprises a communication receiving module, a communication sending module and a quantum channel between the communication receiving module and the communication sending module. A first phase modulator in the communication receiving module can prepare photons at four phases randomly for the communication sending module, and a single-photon detector obtains a quantum bit by detecting the photons returned by the communication sending module; the communication sending module comprises a coding light path module and a security detection module. According to the invention, the consistency of the coding light path and the stability of the security detection light path are utilized, the influence of polarization drift caused by birefringence is avoided, the coding light path realizes polarization drift self-compensation, the bit error rate of quantum bits is reduced, and the communication quality is improved.

appln_title: Lattice-based aggregation signature method based on revocable identity
appln_abstract: The invention belongs to the field of digital signature in public key cryptography, and relates to technologies such as an aggregation signature, a one-way hash function, a trap door generation method and an original image sampling method. The lattice-based aggregation signature method based on the revocable identity is provided for solving the problems that in a resource identity-based digital signature method in a quantum computer environment, the identity revocation overhead is large, and the data transmission efficiency is low under the condition that resources are limited. By means of the method, compression of the size of the aggregation signature, dynamic revocation of an aggregation signature user and quantum security of the aggregation signature are achieved.

appln_title: REDUCING ERRORS WITH CIRCUIT GAUGE SELECTION
appln_abstract: Systems and methods for quantum error mitigation are provided. A method can include accessing a quantum system; implementing a plurality of quantum circuits; obtaining a plurality of measurements performed for each of the quantum circuits; determining an estimated average value of an observable of interest (O) f for the quantum circuits based at least in part on the plurality of measurements; and determining an estimated noiseless value of an observable of interest (O) ψ based at least in part on the estimated average value of the observable of interest (O) f using a single-point full depolarizing error model. Each of the plurality of quantum circuits can be implemented by a different sequence of quantum gates as compared to each of the other quantum circuits in the plurality to thereby implement one or more circuit gauges and can be an equivalent logical operation as each of the other quantum circuits in the plurality.

appln_title: A METHOD FOR PRODUCING CLOSELY SPACED GATE STRUCTURES OF A QUANTUM DOT DEVICE
appln_abstract: According to the method of the invention, a plurality of mutually parallel mandrel structures (4,4') is produced on a substrate (1) comprising at least a top layer of semiconductor material. Side spacers (5) are formed on the mandrel structures, and the mandrel structures are removed with respect to the spacers. This involves the formation of an auxiliary layer on the substrate, that enables the selective removal of at least a top portion of the mandrels, followed by the removal of the auxiliary layer and possibly any remaining portions of the mandrels. The gate oxide (10) of a quantum dot device is formed in the areas between the spacers, by a thermal oxidation of the semiconductor material of the substrate. The thermal oxidation enables the formation of a gate oxide having low defect density and a constant thickness. The spacer material (5) is chosen to withstand the thermal oxidation and acts as an insulator between the gate structures (15). The formation of the gate structures (15) as such is done by techniques taken from or similar to the known replacement gate technology.

appln_title: System for fabricating leg
appln_abstract: Provided is a system for fabricating a leg. The system for fabricating a leg comprises: a shelter frame disposed to enclose a leg; a first rail disposed in a direction where the leg extends; a movement unit guiding that the shelter frame moves along the first rail; a panel disposed in the shelter frame and driven to rotate by a hinge to open and close; a spray gun disposed in an inner wall of the shelter frame and forming a paint film on the leg; and a first sensor sensing the thickness of the paint film formed on the leg.

appln_title: Quantum information system and method with entanglement tracking and generation of verified quantum information using metadata
appln_abstract: Quantum information system with metadata management includes an entangled quantum state source that generates quantum information in quantum form comprising two entangled states. A metadata collector generates metadata in classical form associated with the generated quantum information. A first receiver measures one of the two entangled states to generate quantum state information in classical form comprising a first state value and first TOA. A second receiver is configured to measure the other entangled states to generate quantum state information in classical form comprising a second state value and second TOA. A first processor generates a comb using the first TOA and the metadata to tag the generated quantum state information in classical form comprising the first state value. A second processor coupled to the first processor and to the second receiver is configured to process the comb and metadata to determine correlated data associated with the two entangled states.

appln_title: Functional connecting assembly for building quakeproof support
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a functional connecting assembly for a building quakeproof support. The device comprises a steering adjusting plate and an adjusting alignment plate, the steering adjustingplate is mounted at the front end of the left side of the adjusting alignment plate; a built-in sandwich plate is arranged at the rear end of the adjusting alignment plate; a connecting pin at the front end part of the connecting assembly can be rotated by loosening the steering positioning bolt; rotary steering adjusting plate, therefore, the mounting angle of the position of the connected building quakeproof bracket is adapted; the rear end part of the connecting component can be connected with the shockproof connecting bracket according to the width of the connected shockproof connecting bracket; penetrating bolt by loosening, the distances between the left and right right fixed clamping blocks and the left fixed clamping block are adjusted by sliding left and right; and the right fixing clamping block and the left fixing clamping block can stretch across the building quakeproof support needing to be connected, connection between the two building quakeproof supports can be completed by making bolts penetrate through the quakeproof support mounting holes B in the lower end, adjustment operation is easy and convenient, the application types are various, and the practicability ofthe device is greatly improved.

appln_title: QUANTUM BIT ROUTING
appln_abstract: To provide quantum bit routing.SOLUTION: A method may include obtaining a graph in which a first and a second node respectively represent a first qubit and a second qubit. The method may include generating candidate paths between the first and second qubits along one or more edges, each candidate path specifying a path that arrives at a target edge between a first node and a second node. The method may include computing scores for a plurality of path pairs, a respective score indicating how efficiently a respective path pair routes the first node to the second node via a target edge. The score may be weighted based on an order in which operations of a quantum circuit are performed with earlier operations being weighted more heavily than later operations. The method may include selecting the path pair that corresponds to a highest score for routing the first node to the second node via the target edge.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 6

appln_title: Onion-like graphite nanosphere counter electrode of sensitized solar cell and preparation method of onion-like graphite nanosphere counter electrode
appln_abstract: The invention discloses an onion-like graphite nanosphere counter electrode of a sensitized solar cell and a preparation method of the counter electrode. The onion-like graphite nanosphere counter electrode is that a catalyst layer composed of onion-like graphite nanospheres grows on a fluorine-doped conductive glass FTO (Fluorinedoped Tin Oxide). The preparation method comprises the steps of (1) fixing a candle on an experiment table; (2) fixing a cleaned FTO on a lifting table; (3) lighting the candle; after the FTO stays in the flame for a moment, obtaining the carbon counter electrode composed of onion-like graphite nanospheres on the FTO. The onion-like graphite nanosphere counter electrode has the advantages of high catalytic activity, high stability and the like; in the dye-sensitized solar cell assembled by the onion-like graphite nanosphere counter electrode, the photoelectric conversion efficiency is slightly higher than that of the dye-sensitized solar cell based on traditional Pt counter electrode. The preparation method has a simple process and low cost, reduces the manufacturing cost of the dye-sensitized solar cell and the quantum dot sensitized solar cell and is environmentally-friendly, so that the method is suitable for industrialized production.

appln_title: COMMUNICATION APPARATUS AND COMMUNICATION HISTORY MANAGEMENT PROGRAM
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a communication apparatus capable of recording incoming call history on an execution environment in accordance with a calling party, in a plurality of execution environments.SOLUTION: A communication apparatus operates on an OS and comprises: a plurality of execution environments each of which has incoming call history storing incoming-call information; and a selection section. The selection section notifies a calling phone number to a plurality of execution environments, inquires whether to receive or not, and selects a receiving execution environment from the plurality of execution environments based on the inquiry result. The selected execution environment records the incoming-call information which includes a phone number on the incoming call history.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 2

appln_title: Omnibearing soothing massage bed
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses an all-directional relieving massage bed which comprises a bed frame, an upper body massage support is transversely and slidably installed on the bed frame, an upper body massager set is arranged on the upper body massage support, and a left-right reciprocating driver is arranged between the upper body massage support and the bed frame. A leg massage device is arranged on the bed frame; a dragging frame capable of sliding in the height direction of a human body is installed on the bed frame, a front dragging part and a rear dragging part are fixedly arranged on the dragging frame, and a flexible dragging pad covering the upper body massager set and the leg massaging device is arranged between the front dragging part and the rear dragging part. And a reciprocating dragging driver is arranged between the dragging frame and the bed frame. The upper body massager set can conduct left-right reciprocating massage along with the upper body massage support, legs are massaged by the leg massage device, the flexible dragging pad drives the human body to conduct reciprocating motion in the height direction, the massage direction is remarkably increased, the massage efficiency is high, and the relieving effect is good.

appln_title: Code decoupling protection method based on TF card firmware extension
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a code decoupling protection method based on TF card firmware extension, and belongs to the technical field of security isolation. According to the method, key codes are decoupled to a CPU and other devices (including a solid-state disk master control chip, a USB flash disk master control chip, a TF card master control chip and the like), and the key codes run separately in two (or more) execution environments (a host and a remote execution environment). The TF card is expanded, and key codes are decomposed into host codes and remote codes to be executed separately. The two execution domains do not share a memory and are in an asymmetric form. The preset code does not need to be written into the TF card by the host, and the host program can directly call the function for data processing. And if it is found that the TF card executes unauthorized illegal operation, starting a self-destruction measure. Wherein the key code decoupling is the core, the execution domain division is the premise, and the direct calling of the TF card function for data processing is the necessary condition. According to the method, malicious behaviors from the host are effectively avoided, and the universality is higher.

appln_title: Auxiliary qubits analysis based on partial compilation of quantum programs
appln_abstract: An apparatus, product and method includes partially compiling a quantum circuit from an initial cycle and until one or more intermediate cycles. A partial executable quantum circuit and measurements regarding a group of candidate auxiliary qubits are obtained by executing the partial executable quantum circuit multiple times and classifying the group of candidate auxiliary qubits to a qubit class with respect to a target group of qubits. The qubit class indicates that the group of candidate auxiliary qubits is not entangled with the target group. The quantum circuit is modified to apply a cleaning process on the group of candidate auxiliary qubits, whereby a modified quantum circuit is obtained. The modified quantum circuit is compiled thus obtaining an executable quantum circuit.

appln_title: Cylindrical roller bearing assembly machine capable of automatically feeding
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a cylindrical roller bearing assembly machine capable of automatically feeding, which belongs to the technical field of bearing processing, and comprises a bottom plate, the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower surface of a vibration disc, the upper surface of the bottom plate is fixedly connected with the lower surface of a support, the upper surface of the support is mutually clamped with the bottom end of a motor, and the bottom end of the motor is fixedly connected with the vibration disc. The bottom end of the motor is in transmission connection with the top end of a rotating shaft through a support, the bottom end of the rotating shaft is fixedly connected with the upper surface of a limiting plate, the upper surface of a bottom plate is clamped with the outer surface of a stand column, and the top end of a connecting rod is fixedly connected with the lower surface of a rotating disc. According to the cylindrical roller bearing assembling machine capable of achieving automatic feeding, by arranging the rotating shaft and the rotating disc, the time for manually assembling cylindrical roller bearings is effectively shortened, the assembling efficiency of the bearings is improved, the labor intensity of workers is reduced, meanwhile, the surfaces of bearing rollers are prevented from being collided or scratched, and therefore the product quality is guaranteed.

appln_title: Reinforced concrete waist rail structure
appln_abstract: The utility model relates to a building trade, in particular to underground structure. A reinforced concrete waist rail structure is proposed, including the steel reinforcement cage skeleton and pour the concrete structure layer inside and outside the steel reinforcement cage skeleton, the steel reinforcement cage skeleton is become by longitudinal reinforcement and stirrup ligature, is provided with fore -and -aft anti splitting reinforcing bar net in the steel reinforcement cage skeleton, and anti splitting reinforcing bar net and steel reinforcement cage skeleton bound connection are provided with the lacing wire in the steel reinforcement cage skeleton, the lacing wire is horizontal set up and with longitudinal reinforcement and stirrup bound connection, interval distribution has the reinforcement reinforcing bar on the steel reinforcement cage skeleton, consolidates the one end and steel reinforcement cage skeleton bound connection of reinforcing bar, and the other end stretches out the steel reinforcement cage skeleton. The utility model has the advantages of simple structure, underground structure's is stable good, improves construction speed, reduces construction cost, can be extensive be applied to in the building trade.

appln_title: QUANTUM COMPUTATIONS OF CLASSICAL SPECIFICATIONS
appln_abstract: Systems, computer-implemented methods, and computer program products to facilitate quantum domain computation of classical domain specifications are provided. According to an embodiment, a system can comprise a memory that stores computer executable components and a processor that executes the computer executable components stored in the memory. The computer executable components can comprise an input transformation component that can be adapted to receive one or more types of domain-specific input data corresponding to at least one of a plurality of domains. The input transformation component can transform the one or more types of domain-specific input data to quantum-based input data. The computer executable components can further comprise a circuit generator component that, based on the quantum-based input data, can generate a quantum circuit.

appln_title: Direct-current filtering structure layout of MOSFET power module
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses an MOSFET power module DC filtering structure layout comprising an installation support, the installation support comprises a bottom supporting frame, a side baffle plate and an installation connecting plate, two sides of the lower end of the installation connecting plate are symmetrically connected with fixed pulling plates, and the lower ends of the fixed pulling plates are fixedly connected with one side of the bottom supporting frame; mounting bolt holes are formed in the upper end of the mounting connecting plate, mounting blocks are symmetrically connected to the two ends of the mounting connecting plate, and side baffles are mounted on the mounting blocks. According to the MOSFET power module direct current filtering structure layout, the bottom supporting frame, the side baffles and the mounting connecting plate form the mounting support, the first PCB and the second PCB are vertically arranged and distributed in a three-dimensional mode, space is saved, mounting is convenient, meanwhile, the water cooling device is arranged below the first PCB and used for cooling the first PCB, the cooling fan is arranged between the first PCB and the second PCB, and the cooling effect is good. And through dual cooling, the heat dissipation effect is improved.

appln_title: CHARGING CONNECTOR HOLDING STRUCTURE OF CHARGING DEVICE FOR VEHICLE
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a charging connector holding structure of a charging device for vehicle such that a hold angle adjusting mechanism capable of adjusting a hold angle of a charging connector by rotating a charging connector holding part is constituted with a simple structure.SOLUTION: The charging connector holding structure of the charging device for vehicle includes the charging connector holding part 3 which holds a charging connector 1 in a non-charging state, and a lock hole 8 for locking a lock claw 5 formed at a tip part of the charging connector 1 is formed in the charging connector holding part 3, which holds the charging connector 1 rotatably in a horizontal direction around a lock position between the lock hole 8 and the lock claw 5.

appln_title: Quicklime drying room
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a quicklime drying room which comprises a quicklime room and a drying room. A quicklime feeding door is arranged on the outer side of the quicklime room, a dust collection hopper is arranged below the quicklime room, a dust discharging gate is arranged in a lower port of the dust collection hopper, a dust collection pool is positioned below the dust collection hopper, a plurality of mesh screens are mounted in the quicklime room, a drying frame for laying materials or a material placing vehicle is arranged in the drying room, a material access door is arranged on the outer side of the drying room, a dust collecting chamber is arranged between the quicklime room and the drying room, a filtering wall is arranged in the middle of the dust collecting chamber, an exhaust fan is arranged on the wall of the dust collecting chamber isolated from the quicklime room, a drying fan is arranged on the wall of the dust collecting chamber isolated from the drying room, and a ventilation duct is arranged on one side or at the bottom of the dust collecting chamber and connected with the drying room and the quicklime room. The quicklime drying room overcomes the shortcoming that an existing drying facility needs to consume a lot of energy for drying and is high in cost. The quicklime drying room is less in energy consumption, low in cost and free in pollution.

appln_title: Injection molding storage device with drying effect for injection molding machine
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses an injection molding storage device with a drying effect for an injection molding machine, which relates to the field of injection molding and comprises a support frame and a storage frame, a driving motor is mounted at the top of the support frame, the output end of the driving motor is connected with a stirring shaft, and a limiting component and a plugging component are respectively arranged in the support frame. The plugging assembly comprises a plugging disc mounted in the supporting frame and a plugging plate connected to the stirring shaft in a sleeving manner. Through the arrangement of the plugging assembly, the plugging disc is in contact with the material storage frame, so that the plugging disc can plug the material storage frame, hot air entering the material storage frame is prevented from quickly flowing out through the opening in the top of the material storage frame, the loss efficiency of the hot air is further reduced, and the utilization efficiency of the hot air is improved; and meanwhile, when drying is not carried out, the blocking disc blocks the material storage frame all the time, moisture is prevented from making contact with the injection molding material, and the moisture-proof effect of the injection molding material is improved.

appln_title: SYSTEM OF FREQUENCY SYNCHRONIZATION APPARATUS OF FREQUENCY SYNCHRONIZATION METHOD OF FREQUENCY SYNCHRONIZATION AND METHOD OF THE SAME FOR QUANTUM CLOCK
appln_abstract: The present embodiment relates to a system, an apparatus, and a method of quantum frequency synchronization, and a method of quantum frequency synchronization for a clock. The method of quantum frequency synchronization, which is a method of quantum frequency synchronization within a network including a first device and a second device sharing a singlet state, comprises the following steps: determining whether desynchronization is performed according to a frequency drift based on the singlet state; and performing resynchronization based on a determination result of the desynchronization.

appln_title: DIELECTRIC CHARACTERISTICS MEASURING METHOD USING ATOMIC FORCE MICROSCOPE
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To allow dielectric characteristics such as local dielectric relaxation characteristics on a sample immersed in a liquid to be measured.SOLUTION: An excitation voltage generated by amplitude modulating a carrier wave voltage having a frequency of fby a modulated wave voltage having a frequency of fis applied between a thin metallic film 5a formed on a cantilever 5 of an atomic force microscope and a sample holder 2 on which a conductive sample 3 is placed from an excitation voltage generating section 21. When the frequency of fbecomes higher than a dielectric relaxation frequency of an electric double layer of an interfacial surface between the cantilever 5 and a liquid, a vibration due to electrostatic force acting between a probe 6 and the sample 3 is induced by the cantilever 5. As a result that the electrostatic force has probe-sample distance dependency, local dielectric characteristics on the sample 3 can be obtained by examining frequency dispersion of the characteristics.

appln_title: IMPROVED BLOCKCHAIN SYSTEM AND METHOD
appln_abstract: The present disclosure relates to a quantum-analogue proof-of-work consensus method for use in a blockchain network. The method comprises: receiving a plurality of verification data obtained using a boson sampling experiment associated with a candidate block, from a plurality of different miners of the blockchain network. Each verification data may be associated with a different miner, and wherein each miner performs the boson sampling experiment using at least some information comprised in the candidate block. The method may comprise analysing the received plurality of verification data to determine if a consensus has been achieved; and adding the candidate block to a blockchain associated to the blockchain network when consensus is achieved.

appln_title: Portable blood cell analyzer
appln_abstract: The invention applies to the technical field of medical detection instruments, and provides a portable blood cell analyzer. The portable blood cell analyzer comprises a reagent system, a liquid circuit system, a counting container, a liquid absorption system and an electronic control system, wherein the liquid absorption system comprises a liquid waste pump and a base, and tiny holes and electrodes are arranged on the counting container; a cavity is formed in the lower part of the base and the liquid waste pump is communicated with the cavity. The counting container is detachably mounted on the base, and inside of the counting container is communicated with the cavity in the base through the tiny holes; a liquid in the counting container passes through the tiny holes of the liquid adsorption system, and the electronic control system is used for counting cells discharged from the tiny holes. According to the blood cell analyzer, the counting container can be dismounted and replaced after usage; neither the tiny holes nor the liquid circuit structure is required to be cleaned, so that the cost, the size and the weight of the analyzer are reduced; besides, an opening container accommodating a liquid is not required for storage of the counting container, and the analyzer can be smaller, lighter and convenient to carry.

appln_title: Diamond composite tooth impact resistance detection device
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a diamond composite tooth shock resistance detection device which comprises a support and an impact ball, the support is provided with a clamp, a sleeve and an impactor used for repeatedly impacting the impact ball, and the sleeve is located above the clamp. The impact ball is movably arranged in the sleeve, and an impact window for the impact ball to impact the diamond composite teeth is formed in the bottom of the sleeve. The impacter impacts the diamond composite tooth at high frequency, the actual use state of the diamond composite tooth is simulated, the detection error is reduced, and the impact resistance of the diamond composite tooth is measured through the product value of the single impact energy value, the impact frequency and the impact time of the impacter. The fatigue impact resistance of the diamond composite tooth can be accurately reflected, and the reliability is high.

appln_title: MANUFACTURING METHOD AND MANUFACTURING DEVICE OF GROUP III NITRIDE CRYSTAL
appln_abstract: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a manufacturing device of a group III nitride crystal having productivity improved by suppressing thermal decomposition of a nitrogen element-containing gas.SOLUTION: A manufacturing device of a group III nitride crystal includes a chamber, a nitrogen element-containing gas inlet tube for introducing a nitrogen element-containing gas into the chamber, a holder for holding a group III oxide, a first heater for heating the holder, a reductive gas inlet tube for supplying a reductive gas to the group III oxide, a reduced substance gas supply port for supplying a reduced substance gas of the group III oxide reduced by the reductive gas to the chamber, an exhaust port for discharging the reduced substance gas of the group III oxide and the nitrogen element-containing gas to the outside of the chamber, and a second heater for heating a seed substrate in the chamber. The distance between the holder and the first heater is shorter than the distance between the nitrogen element-containing gas inlet tube and the first heater.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

appln_title: Differential Coupling of Quantum Bit Chips
appln_abstract: A package structure comprises a first quantum bit chip and a second quantum bit chip bonded to an interposer, and a differential coupling bus. The differential coupling bus is configured to differentially couple the first quantum bit chip and the second quantum bit chip at least in part through differential transmission lines disposed on the interposer.

appln_title: Telescopic network camera
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a telescopic network camera which comprises a base, supporting legs are fixedly connected to the positions, close to the four corners, of the bottom of the base, a rolling mechanism is arranged at the bottom of the base, an N-shaped plate is fixedly connected to the middle position of the top of the base, and a lifting mechanism is arranged at the middle position of the top of the base. According to the utility model, the lifting mechanism is arranged, and the hand-cranking wheel, the mounting block, the worm, the worm gear, the second threaded rod, the threaded pipe, the circular pipe and the limiting block are matched with one another, so that the height of the camera body can be conveniently adjusted, and the shooting range of the device is increased; through mutual cooperation of a supporting block, a servo motor, a driving gear, a driven gear, a transmission rod, a first bevel gear, a second bevel gear, a first threaded rod, a threaded sleeve, a movable plate, universal wheels and a limiting plate, movement of the device is facilitated, and the working intensity of workers is relieved.

appln_title: Preparation method of crab spawn dumplings
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a preparation method of crab spawn dumplings. The preparation method for the crab spawn dumplings comprises the following steps: (1) inspecting and accepting raw materials; (2) kneading dough: adding water into wheat flour, stirring and kneading into dough, and standing for several minutes for later use; (3) preparing dumpling wrapper: cutting the dough into small blocks, pressing into round-cake-shaped dough, and rolling by rotating clockwise with a rolling pin on one hand and with the round-cake-shaped dough on the other end to prepare the dumpling wrapper with the diameter of about 6 cm; (4) preparing fillings: stirring crab spawn, crab meat and crab paste uniformly according to the ratio for later use; (5) wrapping: placing the dumpling wrapper on the palm, putting the fillings and wrapping into the dumplings of different shapes; (6) sterilizing: quickly freezing at the temperature of -18 DEG C for sterilizing after wrapping; (7) packaging and warehousing; and (8) passing through a metal detector. The crab spawn dumplings are delicious.

appln_title: COMPOSITE MATERIAL COMPRISED OF UNDRIED, COATED TITANIUM DIOXIDE PARTICLES AND NANOCELLULOSE
appln_abstract: The invention relates to a composite material comprised of an undried, coated titanium dioxide pigment particle and nanocellulose. In addition, the present invention pertains to a method for obtaining said composite material, and to the composite material obtained by said method. Finally, the present invention relates to an aqueous slurry and the use of the aqueous slurry in the manufacture of paper, décor papers, corrugated cardboards, and packaging.

appln_title: Riveting stack structure of automatic folding riveting plate of motor iron core
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a riveting stack structure of an automatic folding riveting plate of a motor iron core; the riveting stack structure is distributed on the riveting plate; the cross section of the riveting stack point of the riveting stack structure is in a shape of waist drum, two ends of which are big while the middle of which is small; the riveting stack structure comprises a cylindrical concave hole; two sides of the concave hole are provided with arc-shaped plates towards the center of a circle; the outer edge of the arc-shaped plate is arc-shaped, the arc-shaped plates at two sides are used for surrounding the concave hole into the waist drum groove for forming concave pit of the riveting stack point; the groove bottom of the waist drum groove bulges towards the lower surface of the riveting plate for forming the lug boss of the riveting stack point. The arc-shaped plates at two sides of the waist drum-shaped riveting stack point have stretch deformation and enable the lug boss to insert in the concave pit smoothly when larger interference is at present, so that larger interference can be ensured by the riveting stack structure of the automatic folding riveting plate of the motor iron core, the riveting stack strength is improved, relatively good appearance can be kept at riveting time, and the bottom dead centre precision requirement is reduced for the machine tool.

appln_title: FREQUENCY-DOMAIN ARBITRARY LINEAR TRANSFORMATIONS FOR PHOTONS
appln_abstract: One or more optical resonators are coupled to an optical waveguide in sequence. Each of the resonators includes a corresponding modulator. A signal controller is configured to electrically drive each modulator with a corresponding composite electrical signal. Each composite electrical signal includes two or more frequency components of a frequency comb defined by the one or more resonators. The result of this configuration is that an input-output relation between an input of the waveguide and an output of the waveguide is a linear transformation defined by the composite electrical signals using frequencies of the frequency comb as a basis. Such linear transformations can be reciprocal or non-reciprocal, unitary or non-unitary.

appln_title: Optical dynamic non-locality induction bit
appln_abstract: A quantum dynamical non-locality device is provided for establishing a photon traveling along a path in a binary state. The device includes twin Mach-Zehnder interferometer (MZI), a shutter and a detector. The twin MZI includes first and second right-isosceles triangle prisms, corresponding first and second trombone mirrors, and corresponding first and second spacers. The prisms join at a beam-splitter interface. The mirrors reflect the photon by an offset substantially perpendicular to photon's travel direction. The spacers are respectively disposed between their respective prisms and mirrors to produce corresponding spatial gaps. The path through the prisms includes traversing spacers and gaps. The detector detects a quantum state of the photon after passing the prisms and the mirrors. The shutter switches to one of disposed within and removed therefrom the first gap. The shutter shifts said quantum state of the photon.

appln_title: QUANTUM DEVICE AND QUANTUM COMPUTER
appln_abstract: A quantum device 10 includes: a data quantum bit 11; a readout resonator 12 coupled to the data quantum bit 11; a readout waveguide 13 coupled to the readout resonator 12; and a nonlinear filter 14 interposed between the readout resonator 12 and the readout waveguide 13. The nonlinear filter 14 has different transmission characteristics depending on the amplitude of a readout pulse input to the readout waveguide 13.

appln_title: Heating device of reflow soldering equipment and reflow soldering equipment
appln_abstract: The utility model relates to the technical field of machining equipment, and provides a heating device of reflow soldering equipment and the reflow soldering equipment. The heating device of the reflow soldering equipment comprises a shell, an air supply component and a heating component, the shell is provided with an air outlet, an air return port, an air supply duct and an air return duct, and the air outlet is communicated with the air return port; the air supply component is provided with an outlet and an inlet which are communicated with each other, the outlet, the air supply duct and the air outlet are communicated to form an air supply path, and the air return port, the air return duct and the inlet are communicated to form an air return path; the heating component is located in an ascending channel of the air supply channel. The utility model provides a heating device of reflow soldering equipment, which solves the problem that an air supply component is easy to burn out due to high hot air temperature, reduces the requirement on high temperature resistance of the air supply component, can reduce the cost of the air supply component, and is beneficial to prolonging the service life of the air supply component and the heating device.

appln_title: METHOD FOR PREPARING JOSEPHSON JUNCTION, JOSEPHSON JUNCTION, AND QUANTUM CHIP
appln_abstract: Embodiments of the present specification provide a method for preparing a Josephson junction and a Josephson junction. The method comprises: providing a substrate, and forming a first photoresist layer on the substrate, the first photoresist layer being provided with a through first channel, the first channel comprising an upper channel and a lower channel having a width greater than that of the upper channel, the lower channel being located between the upper channel and the substrate, and the projection of the first photoresist layer on the substrate located in the lower channel forming a shielded region; performing oblique evaporation in a direction perpendicular to an extension of the first channel so as to form a first superconducting wire on the substrate in the first channel; stripping off the first photoresist layer, and forming a second photoresist layer on the substrate, the second photoresist layer being provided with a second channel having a structure the same as that of the first channel and extending in a direction perpendicular to the first channel; and forming a barrier layer on the portion of the surface of the first superconducting wire located in the second channel. According to the above technical method, the requirements for the resolution of a mask aligner are reduced, thereby reducing costs and increasing the yield.

appln_title: Mask and manufacturing method thereof, and manufacturing method of Josephson junction
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a mask and a manufacturing method thereof, and a manufacturing method of a Josephson junction. The mask comprises a first photoresist layer used for being formed on a substrate, and a through window is formed in the first photoresist layer; the second photoresist layer is formed on the first photoresist layer, a first groove and a second groove which are communicated with the window and are not communicated with each other are formed in the area, corresponding to the window, of the second photoresist layer, and the end face of the second groove faces the side face of the first groove. The manufacturing method of the Josephson junction uses the mask formed by the mask or the manufacturing method of the mask, when the Josephson junction is manufactured, the first superconducting layer is formed through direct evaporation of the first groove, and then the second superconducting layer located on at least part of the barrier layer is formed through oblique evaporation of the second groove. According to the invention, the thickness of the barrier layer and the line width of the superconducting layer are more uniform, so that the normal-temperature resistance of the Josephson junction is more uniform.

appln_title: METHODS, SYSTEMS, AND APPARATUSES FOR PRODUCING, GENERATING AND UTILIZING POWER AND ENERGY
appln_abstract: Methods, systems, and apparatuses for generating, producing, and utilizing energy.

appln_title: Industrial network monitoring device
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses an industrial network monitoring device which comprises a monitoring device body, a plug connector, a fixing piece, a first fixing frame, a second fixing frame, a second motor and a hollow interlayer, the plug connector is installed on the left side of the monitoring device body, wedge-shaped blocks are arranged on a second installation groove, and a plurality of firstsprings are evenly distributed between two limiting blocks. A third mounting groove is formed in the fixing piece, and a pushing block is arranged on the side, away from the third mounting groove, ofthe pushing rod; a second fixing frame is arranged on the left side of the first fixing frame, a supporting plate is arranged in the middle in the left side of the second fixing frame, and a second semicircular protruding block is arranged on the right side of the gear; a balancing weight is arranged on the lower portion of the left side in the second fixing frame, and hollow interlayers are arranged in the wall bodies of the first fixing frame and the second fixing frame. According to the utility model, through the arrangement of the balancing weight, when the whole device falls off, one sideof the balancing weight falls to the ground firstly, so that a protection effect on the monitoring device body is achieved.

appln_title: Electrical heating body used for electrical heater of warm air blower
appln_abstract: The invention relates to an electrical heating body suitable for an electrical heater of a warm air blower, which comprises electrical heating wires and an outer housing, wherein the S-shaped electrical heating wires are fixed on two side faces of a wire lying block; one end of the section of the wire lying block is rectangle, and the other end of the section is of an isosceles triangle; a layer of heat-resisting aluminium foil is wrapped between the electrical heating wires and the outer housing. Therefore, the electrical heating body is safer and firm in design, and high in heating efficiency.

appln_title: Electric drive axle with double motors, double planetary gear sets and differential mechanism
appln_abstract: The invention provides an electric drive axle with double motors, double planetary gear sets and a differential mechanism. A first motor and a second motor are coaxially installed, and a first planetary gear set and a second planetary gear set are coaxially installed; a first motor shaft is connected with a first motor shaft gear, the first motor shaft gear is in external meshing connection with aleft input gear, and the left input gear is connected with a first inner gear ring; a left output gear is connected with a rotating arm of the first planetary gear set and connected with a left halfshaft. A second motor shaft is connected with a second motor shaft gear, and the second motor shaft gear is in external meshing connection with a first right input gear and a second right input gear;the first right input gear is connected with a first sun gear; the second right input gear is connected with a second inner gear ring; and an right output gear is connected with a second rotating armof the second planetary gear set, and is connected with a right half shaft. Constant-speed driving and differential driving of the left half shaft and the right half shaft are effectively achieved; the electric drive axle has the advantages of small size, light weight, high transmission efficiency, low energy consumption and the like.

appln_title: CONNECTING AND DISCONNECTING DEVICE FOR CLUTCH
appln_abstract: A connecting and disconnecting device (30; 150) of a clutch (16) includes a clutch pedal (50), a clutch cylinder (54), a power transmission mechanism (56; 152), an electric actuator (70; 168), and a separation mechanism (76; 160). The power transmission mechanism is configured to transmit depressing force of the clutch pedal as operating force for the clutch cylinder. The electric actuator is connected to the power transmission mechanism so as to allow power transmission. The electric actuator is configured to apply the operating force to the clutch cylinder through the power transmission mechanism. The separation mechanism is provided on a portion of a power transmission path in the power transmission mechanism, the portion being between the clutch pedal and the electric actuator.

appln_title: Screen printer cleaning apparatus using bi-diractional rotaion of wiper and Method thereof
appln_abstract: PURPOSE: A screen printer cleaning device using the two-way rotation of a wiper and a method thereof are provided to utilize a wiper recovery shaft and a wiper supply shaft capable of the two-way rotation, thereby preventing residues on the underside of a stencil mask. CONSTITUTION: A screen printer cleaning device(50) comprises a cleaning block(70), a first shaft(51), and a second shaft(52). The cleaning block pushes a wiper arranged in one side of a stencil mask, thereby contacting the wiper to the stencil mask and moving with the wiper in left and right sides. The first shaft supplies the wiper. The second shaft returns the wiper.

appln_title: PROCESSING DEVICE AND METHOD FOR QUANTUM CONTROL SYSTEM, QUANTUM COMPUTER, MEDIUM, AND ELECTRONIC DEVICE
appln_abstract: A processing device and method for a quantum control system, a quantum computer, a medium, and an electronic device. The processing device comprises: a task receiving module (11), configured to receive and store a quantum computing task to be executed; a first task management module (12), configured to acquire a next quantum computing task to be executed from the stored quantum computing task and send a bit resource request according to corresponding task information, wherein the bit resource request is represented as a quantum bit required by the next quantum computing task to be executed; and a resource management module (13), configured to receive the bit resource request, allocate a quantum bit in an idle state according to a physical topological structure of a quantum chip and state information of the quantum bit, and mark the state information of the allocated quantum bit as a working state.

appln_title: Exhaust gasket with positioning notches
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses an exhaust gasket with positioning notches. The exhaust gasket comprises a gasket body, a plurality of vent holes are evenly formed in the gasket body, an inner wall of each vent hole is respectively provided with a polytetrafluoroethylene coating, the front edge of the gasket body between every two adjacent vent holes is respectively provided with a positioning notch, the gasket body on the two sides of each positioning notch is respectively provided with a sunk side installing hole, and the periphery of the gasket body is further provided with a plurality of flat edge installing holes. The exhaust gasket is accurately positioned and tightly sealed through the positioning notches and the sunk side installing hole, and due to the polytetrafluoroethylene coatings, the exhaust gasket is better in abrasion resistance and sealing performance and longer in service life.

appln_title: Fireproof and noise-reducing wall decorative picture as well as mounting structure and production process thereof
appln_abstract: The invention discloses a fireproof and noise-reducing wall decorative picture and a mounting structure and a production process thereof, the wall decorative picture comprises a first glass fiber cloth layer, a first glass fiber felt layer, a glass fiber cotton layer and a second glass fiber felt layer which are arranged from the front side to the back side and are sequentially adhered through an adhesive, and the side edge of the glass fiber cotton layer is provided with a hardening area. Meanwhile, the side edge of the glass fiber cotton layer is coated with a third glass fiber felt layer, and patterns are printed on the outer surface of the first glass fiber cloth layer. The wall surface decorative picture is formed by compounding the glass fiber felt, the glass fiber cotton and the glass fiber cloth and is made of the glass fibers, and the glass fibers have the fireproof and non-combustible characteristics, so that the whole wall surface decorative picture achieves the fireproof effect.

appln_title: Interposer chips and enclosures for quantum circuits
appln_abstract: Techniques regarding qubit chip assemblies are provided. For example, one or more embodiments described herein can include an apparatus that can comprise a qubit chip positioned on an interposer chip. The apparatus can also comprise an electrical connector in direct contact with the interposer chip. The electrical connector can establish an electrical communication between a wire and a contact pad of the interposer chip that is coupled to the qubit chip.

appln_title: Low-voltage floor type distribution box convenient to install
appln_abstract: The utility model discloses a low-voltage floor type distribution box convenient to install, which comprises a box body, a box door and an installation table matched with the box body for use, slideways are arranged on the two sides of the installation table, and barrier strips are arranged on the outer sides of the slideways; bases are arranged on the two sides of the outer surface of the bottomend of the box body, clamping grooves and sliding wheels are arranged on the bases, and the sliding wheels are arranged on the inner sides of the clamping grooves; water baffles are arranged on the periphery of the outer surface of the front end of the box body and are of an arc-shaped structure, and a grounding block is arranged on the inner side of the front end of the box body. Thickened edgesare arranged on the peripheral edges of the inner side of the box door, and a sliding padlock is arranged in the center of the edge of the box door. According to the utility model, through the integral design, the installation can be quickly carried out; rainwater can be effectively dredged and isolated by arranging the water baffle, a sealing effect can be achieved by matching with the thickenededge on the distribution box door, the grounding block on the inner side of the distribution box body can be connected with a ground wire, static electricity and unstable voltage are effectively dredged, and the turnups on the heat dissipation holes can isolate rainwater.

appln_title: FRESH CHEESE FERMENTED BY KOMBUCHA
appln_abstract: Kombuha fresh cheese is a new type of fresh cheese produced by the use of kombucha inoculum. Kombucha inoculum of appropriate microbiological composition and functional characteristics enables to obtain a new product - kombucha fresh cheese with good technological characteristics. Kombuha fresh cheese is a product of specific sensory and nutritional characteristics, intended for different categories of consumers.
